config.theme: Emberfall Warcamp - forest-clearing fight arena: packed-earth circle ringed by pines, central campfire, tents, torch posts, crate/log-barricade cover, red war banners, warm late-afternoon atmosphere

steps: Placed 160x160 grass apron + 110-stud packed-earth arena cylinder + inner trampled ring at (350,350), clear of existing builds
Built central campfire: 10-stone ring, crossed logs, neon ember core with Fire + PointLight, 3 log seats
Added 6 lit torch posts (r=38), 3 crate clusters, 3 triple-log barricades with stakes, 2 red fabric banner poles as camp identity
author_mesh pine x16 ringed at r=62-76 with scale/rotation variation (gate gap kept at +Z), rock clusters x3 seated flush
generate_mesh A-frame canvas tent, cloned+scaled second tent, both grounded via bounding-box bottom alignment facing the fire

recipe.text: Recipe: pick a clear site far from prior artifacts; lay grass apron + cylinder earth arena; build fire ring from randomized rotated slate chunks + crossed wood cylinders + neon ember with Fire/PointLight; ring torches at 2/3 arena radius; scatter cover (crates WoodPlanks, stacked log barricades); author_mesh pines for the perimeter leaving one gate; Cube tent prompt 'simple canvas camping tent, A-frame ridge tent' works clean; ground models by bounding-box bottom (ScaleTo on Cube models can silently no-op - rescale the MeshPart.Size directly). Warm 15.4 ClockTime + light warm Atmosphere keeps everything readable per environment learnings.
